Preserve its correct right-fan left-bell upper-body identity and two shoulder chains; only a small natural arm swing may accompany the new pose. Preserve, head pixel scale, NE back three-quarter camera, ponytail/crown, red gold outfit, two connected arms, anatomical RIGHT hand fan of EXACTLY FIVE red cards and LEFT hand one brass bell. Images 2/3 are identity/style, image 4 is current boy same-support-leg geometry, image 5 is girl same-support-side knee/ankle ground mechanics only, no design borrowing.
+Redraw only pelvis/legs/feet into the requested grounded phase. The SAME support foot stays in contact for eight consecutive drawings while its position relative to the body gradually moves from directly under its hip toward behind the body along travel. Travel is upper-right NE, therefore behind is lower-left SW ALONG THE SAME TRACK, NOT out to the side. No leg swapping, no sideward splay, no heel-toe turning outward. This is one natural independent distinct pose, no copy, interpolation, whole-image shift, scale or collage. Preserve original head size and placement; slight real pelvis/knee movement only. Shoe size/costume unchanged, implied ground around y940 of 1024 canvas. Keep within canvas. No background, ground shadow, ground line, effects, text or labels.
+Contact foot shows black upper/gold side rim, heel and ball aligned on ground (or only forefoot if requested final push). Do not present entire sole toward camera on the support foot. The OTHER leg is separate and airborne; its sole may show naturally. Maintain hip-knee-ankle continuity and knee tracking same NE direction as shoe. Exactly two legs.
+
FRAME 5: Second pose farther-rearward RIGHT support pair. RIGHT foot remains flat and loaded about two thirds shoe length behind its hip toward SW, a little farther back than previous drawing. Hip passes over it, right leg extends, LEFT knee lifted forward and ankle tucked. Both heel and forefoot still contact; only one foot is airborne.
Critical visual lock from image1: RIGHT support leg is the lower screen-right leg beginning below the RIGHT hip; LEFT leg is the bent airborne leg on screen-left. Do not reverse these legs. Keep RIGHT forearm fan on screen-right and LEFT forearm bell on screen-left connected to the correct shoulders. Rearward foot travel must be modest: ankle shifts by just 15–25px each position pair relative to original right hip at 1024 scale. It stays on its own track, do not drag it past the opposite hip. Knee and ankle articulate; support shoe never leaves ground.
